description: Renal Clearance and Hepatic Dosing Boundary Policies

renal_rules.explanation: Apixaban requires dose reduction to 2.5mg BID in patients with severe renal impairment (CrCl < 25 mL/min) or meeting 2 of 3 criteria (age >= 80, weight <= 60 kg, serum creatinine >= 1.5 mg/dL). Full 5mg BID carries extreme bleeding hazard.
renal_rules.remediation: Reduce dose to 2.5mg BID or consult clinical pharmacist.

renal_rules.explanation: Vancomycin q12h dosing is strictly contraindicated in severe renal impairment (CrCl < 30 mL/min) without interval extension (q24h-q48h) and AUC/trough monitoring.
renal_rules.remediation: Extend interval to q24-48h and monitor serum trough levels.

hepatic_rules.explanation: Acetaminophen doses exceeding 2000 mg/day in Child-Pugh Class C severe cirrhosis exceed impaired hepatic glutathione capacity, risking acute hepatotoxicity.
hepatic_rules.remediation: Cap acetaminophen dose to maximum 2000 mg/24h or use alternative non-hepatotoxic analgesics.
